section_role: Data processing and synthetic data generation pipeline

method_evidence.claim: Watertight processing on each independent part mesh separately ensures each part is a topologically closed geometric entity.
method_evidence.anchor: watertight processing on each independent part mesh separately, ensuring that each part is a topologically closed geometric entity

method_evidence.claim: Synthetic data generation pipeline consists of text expansion, image generation, and 3D generation.
method_evidence.anchor: our data synthesis pipeline consists of three main steps: text expansion, image generation, and 3D generation

method_evidence.claim: LLM prompt design for text expansion focuses on rationality, visual details, and diversity.
method_evidence.anchor: Our prompt design is centered around the following three points: (1) Ensuring basic rationality and authenticity... (2) Providing rich visual details... (3) Expanding diversity...

method_evidence.claim: Qwen-Image is fine-tuned with LoRA to generate images with clean background, complete object, appropriate position, reasonable viewpoint, and rich information.
method_evidence.anchor: our fine-tuning objective is to enable the model to generate images that meet the following quality standards: (1) Clean background... (2) Complete object... (3) Appropriate position... (4) Reasonable view point... (5) Information-rich...

method_evidence.claim: HY3D-3.0 model is used as the 3D generation engine for high-quality assets with fine geometry and clear textures.
method_evidence.anchor: We select the industry-leading HY3D-3.0 model~\cite{hunyuan3d_online} as our 3D generation engine.

experiment_evidence.claim: Full-level dataset contains 252,676 high-quality 3D assets after filtering and processing.
Dataset split: 252,000 training, 276 validation, 400 test samples.
Part-level dataset comprises 240,524 samples with mean component count 14.13 and median 11.
experiment_evidence.metric: Number of samples / mean components / median components
Percentage of samples per component range
